name: An Apprentice's Enchantment
summary: At the camp, Apprentice Kryten enchants the agate you brought from the Boulderfist shaman. It can wake the tower's defenses, and Kryten sends you to Skuerto before you leave.

sections.title: A Key for the Tower
sections.body: Apprentice Kryten gives you the enchanted gem and explains its power. Touch it to a pedestal at the tower's foot, and its defenses will wake. When you are ready to enter and search for the rest of Trelane's items, use the gem. Kryten will wait for you at the camp. Before you go, speak with Skuerto, who can answer any other questions.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the enchanted agate?
aliases: why do i need the agate
faq.answer: Touch the enchanted agate to a pedestal at the tower's foot, and it wakes the tower's defenses. Use it when you are ready to enter and search for the rest of Trelane's items.

faq.q: Who do you need to talk to before leaving camp?
faq.answer: Speak to Skuerto before you leave the camp. Kryten says Skuerto can answer any other questions.
Kryten will wait for your return at the camp.
